scripts.dev: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env || true; set +a; BRIDGE_PORT=${BRIDGE_PORT:-3457}; VITE_PORT=${VITE_PORT:-5173}; restart_port() { label="$1"; port="$2"; echo "[dev] Restarting ${label} on :${port}"; if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -ti:"${port}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "[dev] Killing existing ${label} PID(s): ${pids}"; echo "$pids" | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "[dev] No existing ${label} process found on :${port}"; fi; fi; }; echo "[dev] Loading environment"; restart_port app-server "$BRIDGE_PORT"; pkill -f "[b]un server/standalone.ts" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "[c]odex.*app-server" 2>/dev/null || true; restart_port vite "$VITE_PORT"; pkill -f "[v]ite.*${VITE_PORT}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "[dev] Waiting for ports to settle..."; sleep 1; echo "[dev] Starting app-server and Vite"; exec concurrently --names server,vite --prefix-colors magenta,green --kill-others-on-fail "sleep 2 && PORT=$BRIDGE_PORT bun run server" "sleep 5 && BRIDGE_PORT=$BRIDGE_PORT vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port $VITE_PORT"'
scripts.dev:frontend: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env || true; set +a; BRIDGE_PORT=${BRIDGE_PORT:-3457}; VITE_PORT=${VITE_PORT:-5173}; restart_port() { label="$1"; port="$2"; echo "[dev] Restarting ${label} on :${port}"; if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -ti:"${port}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "[dev] Killing existing ${label} PID(s): ${pids}"; echo "$pids" | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "[dev] No existing ${label} process found on :${port}"; fi; fi; }; echo "[dev] Loading environment"; restart_port vite "$VITE_PORT"; pkill -f "[v]ite.*${VITE_PORT}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "[dev] Starting frontend only"; export BRIDGE_PORT; exec vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port $VITE_PORT'
